news.title: Socceroos WC heartbreak story returns as Popa’s big questions emerge for Brazil clashes
news.lede: The start of a new World Cup cycle for the Socceroos gets underway on Friday night, with Australia taking on five-time world champions Brazil in a two-game series that starts in Townsville before moving to Brisbane on Tuesday. The fixtures come just months after Tony Popovic’s side exited the last World Cup in North America after a heartbreaking penalty shootout loss to Egypt in the Round of 32, and while there are plenty of familiar faces in the squad named by the manager, there’s also a healthy dose of new blood. news.title: Harry Kane admits England’s World Cup 2026 exit ‘hurt more than any other’
news.lede: ‘It wasn’t the team that we wanted and said we’d be’. England host Spain in Nations League on Saturday. Harry Kane has described England’s World Cup semi-final defeat against Argentina as his most painful tournament exit because of how the team lost sight of who they were. The captain is determined to move on as quickly as possible and is chasing a statement performance against Spain at Wembley on Saturday night in the Nations League.

news.title: PSG and World Cup star Achraf Hakimi will stand trial for rape after losing latest attempt to have case thrown out
news.lede: ACHRAF HAKIMI will stand trial for rape after losing his bid to have the case thrown out. It was announced in June that the PSG and Morocco star would go on trial for an alleged assault on a woman in February 2023. Hakimi, who vehemently denies the allegation, tried to get the case thrown out by lodging a motion to dismiss it with a French appeals court. But on Wednesday, the Cour de cassation rejected his bid to have the case struck off, meaning The Atlas Lions’ talismanic skipper will have to go in the dock to address the allegation.

news.title: Australia national football team players: the 26 Popovic picked for Brazil, and the seven yet to play
news.lede: Tony Popovic has left out Mathew Ryan and called up seven uncapped players for Australia’s two friendlies against Brazil. Here is the full Socceroos squad with caps, goals and clubs. Tony Popovic has named 26 Australia national football team players for two friendlies against Brazil, and seven of them have never played for the Socceroos. It is his first squad since Australia went out of the 2026 World Cup on penalties to Egypt, and he has made ten changes to the group that went to North America.

news.title: Ceferin cites need to repair trust broken by Infantino’s FIFA World Cup plan
news.lede: AP AP https://ss-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/4cw55l/article71501482.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/image%2017.jpeg GENEVA Ceferin led UEFA’s backlash in July that helped stop Infantino’s plan to sell at least 20% of FIFA’s future commercial rights for USD 4.2 billion to investors led by Josh Kushner, the brother of U.S. President Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner. European football leader Aleksander Ceferin said Wednesday it is “our work” to repair the unity and trust broken by FIFA President Gianni Infantino’s failed World Cup sell-off plan. The UEFA president, in rare public comments two months into the divisive global rift in football, did not cite Infantino by name but said “not everyone places the game above their own ambitions.”

news.title: Football: Soccer-Vieira leads wave of new coaches into Africa Cup of Nations qualifying
news.lede: CAPE TOWN, Sept 23 (Reuters) - World ⁠Cup winner Patrick Vieira headlines a lengthy list of new coaches in charge of African ⁠national teams as the group qualifiers for next year’s Africa Cup of Nations finals kick ‌off on Thursday. Vieira takes charge of Senegal, where he was born, as they look to recover from a disappointing World Cup where they were expected to pose Africa’s best challenge at the tournament in Canada, Mexico, and the United States but delivered an underwhelming performance ​that cost their former coach Pape Bouna Thiaw his job. A total ⁠of 21 new coaches will be in ⁠charge this week as 48 countries begin the group phase of the qualifiers. The list includes six of ⁠the ‌10 African countries who competed at the World Cup.
